acceptanceCriteria: The smallest CEM, OCM and frontier profiles needed by the daily loop are frozen with canonical conformance vectors.
Every wire change has an N-1 reader or deterministic migration and preserves unknowns.
Stable, relocated, stale, ambiguous, deleted and unknown evidence each have hostile cases.
body: Freeze portable proof contracts after the daily workflow determines the actual minimum. Avoid standardizing experimental surplus.
title: Freeze the minimum portable proof wire
